entities.name: The River
entities.description: A flood sacred to the Cho-Arrim, representing the cycle of life, death and rebirth; they send their dead down it.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: A people who hold the River sacred.

entities.name: Rushwood
entities.description: Land through which the River winds.

entities.name: Cho-Akhan
entities.description: A Cho-Arrim who found Sia-am-Erh's tomb, took up the Ancestral Mask and emerged from the River changed.

entities.name: Sia-am-Erh
entities.description: An ancient shaman whose tomb lay by the River.

entities.name: Ancestral Mask
entities.description: A relic of immense power that consumed Cho-Akhan.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: City from which a plague swept across the plains.

entities.name: Cho-Ran
entities.description: Cho-Akhan's brother, killed by the plague.

events.summary: While searching for herbs by the River, Cho-Akhan found the tomb of Sia-am-Erh with the Ancestral Mask.
events.quote: Cho-Akhan stumbled upon the ancient tomb of the shaman Sia-am-Erh

events.summary: Plague from Mercadia City killed Cho-Ran, and Cho-Akhan took up the mask; it consumed her and dragged her into the River, bound to the spirits of the fallen.
events.quote: the mask consumed her, dragging her into the depths of the River

events.summary: Cho-Akhan emerged changed and joined her mothers to march against Mercadia City.
events.quote: Emerging from the River forever changed, 'Akhan joined her mothers

relations.quote: claiming the life of Cho-Akhan's brother, Cho-Ran
who hold the River in great esteem
